notes: Eclipse Loop 3.7.0 - leads that are full melodies, a clear step light on every row, step chance, euclidean fills and swing per track, knobs that move by themselves (MOVE), a new Settings window and menu look with a shortcut on every item, and film tools: masks that follow, face blur, streamers, sound effects, lip-sync check and fit the song to the film. Plus Score the Scene (Loop reads your picture and writes a first cue to it), draw a chord, a lyrics harmony voice, low latency monitoring and a Channel Strip where every preamp has its own compressor controls.
